name: Name
overview: The Bible reveals that a name carries profound significance, often reflecting identity, purpose, and divine calling. From Adam naming the creatures (Genesis 2:19) to God renaming Abram as Abraham and Sarai as Sarah to signify their destinies (Genesis 17:5, 15), names convey spiritual meaning and authority. God's own name is described as eternal and a lasting memorial (Exodus 3:15), underscoring its sacredness, which must not be taken in vain (Exodus 20:7). The changing of names, such as Jacob to Israel (Genesis 32:28), symbolizes transformation and spiritual adoption, highlighting the power and value embedded in a good and God-given name.
